manifest.name: dsh-hot-memory
manifest.description: Project the Mnemon runtime memory files (USER.md / MEMORY.md) into every session's system prompt as one lazy section, independent of dsh-mnemon's lifecycle gate.
manifest.author: Ln1m (https://github.com/Ln1m)

bundle.text:
# dsh-hot-memory plugin patch: registers this host-only row into the web profile
# roster. The node half (exports ".") runs in the host process and registers one
# lazy `systemPrompt` section carrying ~/.mnemon/runtime/{USER,MEMORY}.md.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-hot-memory
      name: 'dsh-hot-memory'

readme.text:
> **已归档（2026-09-28）**：面向本机的 Mnemon 补丁，不再维护。

[English](README.en.md) · 中文

把 Mnemon 的运行时记忆文件（`USER.md` / `MEMORY.md`）投影进每个会话的 systemPrompt，作为一个懒加载区段，不受 dsh-mnemon 生命周期门控影响。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:<本仓库>
```

装完重启 web 实例。
- 需先装 dsh-mnemon：记忆文件由它维护，本插件只负责注入

> **Archived (2026-09-28)**: a local-only Mnemon patch, no longer maintained.

[中文](README.md) · English

Projects Mnemon's runtime memory files (`USER.md` / `MEMORY.md`) into every session's system prompt as one lazily loaded section, independent of the dsh-mnemon lifecycle gate.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:<this repo>
```

Restart the web instance afterwards.
- Install dsh-mnemon first: it maintains the memory files, this plugin only injects them
